caption: There’s something about making a special treat for my little girl that fills my heart 💕 After a long day of work and daycare, we slowed down and made this mango, banana, and milk rolled ice cream topped with coconut flakes. It wasn’t anything extravagant—just a simple dessert made with love. Motherhood has taught me that the moments I cherish most aren’t the big milestones, but these small pockets of joy. Watching her excitement, hearing her laugh, and sharing something homemade together after a busy day makes every bit of effort worth it. These are the memories I hope she carries with her, and the ones I know I always will. 🥭🍦✨ #easyrecipe #motherhood #toddlersnacks #toddlermom #icecream
